thread.title: 7 Biggest Price Target Changes For Friday

author: Lisa Levin
title: 7 Biggest Price Target Changes For Friday
text: Lisa Levin , Benzinga Staff Writer {{following ? "Following" : "Follow"}} April 20, 2018 9:55am Comments Share: Credit Suisse lowered the price target for Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOGL ) from $1,400 to $1,350. Alphabet shares closed at $1,089.45 on Thursday. Stifel Nicolaus lowered Philip Morris International Inc. (NYSE: PM ) price target from $125 to $100. Philip Morris shares closed at $85.64 on Thursday. Credit Suisse cut the price target for Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ: FB ) from $240 to $230. Facebook shares closed at $168.10 on Thursday. Morgan Stanley cut Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL ) price target from $203 to $200. Apple shares closed at $172.80 on Thursday. Stifel Nicolaus boosted the price target for Danaher Corporation (NYSE: DHR ) from $108 to $114. Danaher shares closed at $101.50 on Thursday. Credit Suisse boosted the price target on Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN ) from $1,750 to $1,800. Amazon.com shares closed at $1,556.91 on Thursday. Morgan Stanley raised Comerica Incorporated (NYSE: CMA ) price target from $98 to $104. Comerica shares closed at $95.04 on Thursday. © 2018 Benzinga.com. Benzinga does not provide investment advice.
